input.content:
import sys, json, subprocess

src = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
bold = src
for n in "12345":
    bold = bold.replace(
        "\n%s. " % n, "\n%s. **第 %s 步，共 5 步** —— " % (n, n)
    )
open(".probe/bold.md", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(bold)
out = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-I", ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py", "report",
     sys.argv[1], ".probe/bold.md", "--scope=content", "--json"],
    capture_output=True, text=True)
d = json.loads(out.stdout)
a = d["after"]
print("bold-variant total:", a["score"]["total"])
print("x_deduct:", a["score"]["x_deduct"], "x_hits:", a["score"]["x_hits"])
print("typo dim:", a["score"]["dims"]["typo"]["score"])
print("findings:", json.dumps(a["findings"], ensure_ascii=False))

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import re
a=open('input.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
b=open('output.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
print('--- tokens in INPUT missing from OUTPUT ---')
for t in ['100,000','CSV','API','ID','2 分钟','worker','控制台','工作区','维护窗口','权限不足','正在准备','已取消','值班人','筛选条件','原始数据','创建时间','任务列表']:
    print(('OK  ' if t in b else 'MISS'), repr(t), '| in_input:', t in a)
print()
print('--- numbers ---')
print('input  nums:', sorted(set(re.findall(r'\d[\d,]*', a))))
print('output nums:', sorted(set(re.findall(r'\d[\d,]*', b))))
print()
print('--- headings ---')
print('in :', re.findall(r'^#+ .*', a, re.M))
print('out:', re.findall(r'^#+ .*', b, re.M))
print()
print('--- links/code/emoji ---')
print('links in/out:', re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)', a), re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)', b))
print('inline code in/out:', re.findall(r'\`[^\`]*\`', a), re.findall(r'\`[^\`]*\`', b))
import unicodedata
emo=[c for c in b if ord(c)>0x2190 and unicodedata.category(c)=='So']
print('emoji-ish in output:', emo)
"
